title: Build the set once in O(n); every membership question is O(1)
caption: One pass fills the hash set. After that, "is x in it?" never scans the array again.

frames.text: Scan nums once and add each value to seen. After three values the set holds 100, 4 and 200.
The scan is over: all six values are in seen. Building it cost O(n) time and O(n) memory.
"Is 5 in seen?" One hash lookup says no. That's O(1) on average, with no scan of the array.
"Is 3 in seen?" Yes, again in O(1). An inner "search the rest" loop (O(n²) overall) becomes one lookup per question.
